# Community Response Library

| Scenario | Response purpose | Approved response pattern | Required verification | Escalation owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Categories
Product question, service issue, shipping or availability, positive feedback, feature request, misinformation, safety concern, and complaint.

## Usage rules
Treat examples as starting points, not scripts to paste blindly. Personalize only with information the user has provided through approved channels. Never request passwords, payment details, or sensitive personal information in public comments.
